paragraph:
# Velmoria, twenty years on

*A truth commission asks whether a nation can (venerate) its past honestly, or only (adulterate) it*

LET THIS chapter not (exaggerate) the distance travelled. Twenty years after the marshal fell, Velmoria has convened a truth commission—its (penultimate) act of national reckoning before the last living witnesses (emigrate) or die. The body's task is (intimate) and exact: to (enumerate) the regime's crimes, to (corroborate) each from the record, and to decide whom history should (venerate), whom (execrate), and whom merely (commiserate) with.

The commission is, by design, (dispassionate). Its members were chosen to be neither (passionate) partisans nor (inveterate) apologists. They mean to (discriminate) the (legitimate) grievance from the (illegitimate), the (proximate) cause from the distant, the (approximate) memory from the documented fact. They will not (denigrate) the dead nor (adulterate) the truth to soothe the living. Their charge is to (illuminate), not to (indoctrinate).

It would be easy to (procrastinate). Some argued the wound should be left to heal, that to reopen it would only (lacerate) old scars and (alienate) a nation that had begun to (integrate). But the commissioners refused to let the question (dissipate). A truth (separate)d from its evidence, they reasoned, soon begins to (disintegrate); a history on which a nation may only (ruminate) in silence does not heal but (ulcerate)s. Better to (deliberate) openly than to let the past (germinate) into myth.

Recall how the marshal treated memory. He sought to (deracinate) it entirely—to (exterminate) inconvenient facts and (disseminate) flattering lies. His ministry would (eliminate) records, (incinerate) archives, and (impersonate) scholarship with propaganda. He longed to (dominate) the very past and (predominate) over its telling, to have himself (denominate)d the nation's saviour and reborn, in the official liturgy, as something (incarnate)—a leader so essential he might be (reincarnate)d in his heirs. The cult was (inordinate); the (effeminate) flattery of his court, ceaseless.

The commission's hearings (fascinate)d the public. Witnesses, long forced to be (subordinate), spoke at last as free citizens. A (literate) clerk produced a ledger that would (inculpate) three former officials and (exculpate) a wrongly blamed fourth. A village elder, of a near-(preliterate) generation, described how soldiers came to (desecrate) the shrine his people had (consecrate)d. The testimony did not (alliterate) into easy poetry; it was raw, (disparate), and all the more credible for it.

Not everyone cooperated. A clique of the marshal's (unregenerate) loyalists rose to (fulminate) against the proceedings, to (vituperate) the commissioners as traitors, to (abominate) the whole exercise as a show trial. They tried to (concatenate) unrelated grievances into a single (inchoate) rage, to (exaggerate) the costs and (denigrate) the motives. One former (magnate), an (ingrate) grown rich on the regime's spoils, (designate)d himself the voice of the wronged—an (illegitimate) claim the evidence quickly (eviscerate)d. He left the chamber (irate), having (corroborate)d nothing.

Beyond the hearings, the republic's ordinary work goes on. Clinics (vaccinate) the young and tend each fragile (neonate); farmers (pollinate), (aerate), and (hydrate) the recovering fields; a generation that knew only the marshal's (dehydrate)d propaganda now learns to (ruminate) for itself. Cooperatives (agglomerate) into a sturdy (conglomerate) of small producers; the economy does not (proliferate) wildly but grows enough to (remunerate) honest labour and (rejuvenate) the long-neglected provinces. No one need (emigrate) merely to eat.

The commission's final report will not be the (consummate), last word—no such thing exists. It will (adumbrate) rather than (elaborate) every detail, leaving later historians to (iterate) and (reiterate) the work. It declines to (incarcerate) the past in a single (crate) of settled judgement. Its authors know that to let one truth (preponderate) over all others would itself (adulterate) the record. They offer, instead, an honest (penultimate) draft of a story still being written.

So Velmoria does not (venerate) itself for its candour, nor (execrate) itself for its failings. The marshal sought to (deracinate) memory and (dominate) the past; his country, twenty years on, has chosen the harder, more (compassionate) course: to (illuminate) what happened, (corroborate) it, and let a free, (literate), self-governing people decide for themselves what to remember and what to forgive. The instinct toward truth, the commissioners concluded, is not learned but (innate)—and it is, in the end, the one inheritance no tyrant can (exterminate).
translation:
韦尔莫利亚，二十年之后

*一个真相委员会追问：一个国家能否诚实地（敬重缅怀/venerate）它的过往，还是只会（掺假篡改/adulterate）它*

让这一章不要（夸大/exaggerate）已经走过的路程。元帅倒台二十年后，韦尔莫利亚召集了一个真相委员会——这是在最后那些在世证人（移居外迁/emigrate）或离世之前，它进行全国清算的（倒数第二个/penultimate）举措。这个机构的任务（私密切身/intimate）而精确：（逐一列举/enumerate）这个政权的罪行、从记录中为每一项（佐证印证/corroborate)、并裁定历史应当（敬重/venerate）谁、（痛斥憎恶/execrate）谁、又只该（同情怜悯/commiserate）谁。

这个委员会，出于设计，是（冷静不动感情的/dispassionate)。它的成员被选出来时，既不是（充满激情的/passionate）党派之徒，也不是（积习难改的/inveterate）辩护者。他们要做的是（甄别区分/discriminate）（正当合法的/legitimate）冤情与（不正当的/illegitimate）冤情、（最近的直接的/proximate）起因与久远的起因、（大致约略的/approximate）记忆与有据可查的事实。他们不会（诋毁中伤/denigrate）死者，也不会为了抚慰生者而（掺假篡改/adulterate）真相。他们的职责是（照亮阐明/illuminate)，而非（灌输教条/indoctrinate)。

要（拖延耽搁/procrastinate）本是容易的。一些人主张，伤口该任其愈合，重新揭开它只会（撕裂/lacerate）旧疤、（疏远离间/alienate）一个已经开始（融合一体/integrate）的国家。但委员们拒绝让这个问题（消散/dissipate)。他们推断，一个与其证据相（分离/separate）的真相，很快便会开始（瓦解崩散/disintegrate)；一段一个国家只能默默（反复思量/ruminate）的历史，不会愈合，而会（溃烂化脓/ulcerate)。与其任由过往（萌生/germinate）成神话，不如公开地（审议慎议/deliberate)。

回想元帅当年是如何对待记忆的。他力图把它整个（连根拔除/deracinate）——（消灭根除/exterminate）碍事的事实、（散播传布/disseminate）阿谀的谎言。他的部门会（消除/eliminate）记录、（焚毁/incinerate）档案、用宣传去（冒充假扮/impersonate）学术。他渴望（支配主宰/dominate）过往本身、（主导压倒/predominate）对它的讲述，渴望让自己被（命名指称/denominate）为这个国家的救星，并在官方的礼拜文中重生为某种（道成肉身般/incarnate）的存在——一个如此不可或缺的领袖，以至于他可能在他的继承者身上（转世再生/reincarnate)。这个个人崇拜（过度无节制/inordinate)；他宫廷里那（脂粉气娇柔的/effeminate）阿谀，绵绵不绝。

委员会的听证会（使……着迷/fascinate）了公众。证人们，长久以来被迫（屈从下位/subordinate)，终于作为自由公民开口。一个（识字的/literate）文书拿出一本账簿，它会（使……入罪/inculpate）三名前官员、并（开脱洗清/exculpate）一个被错怪的第四人。一位村中长者，属于近乎（文字出现前的/preliterate）一代人，描述了士兵们如何前来（亵渎/desecrate）他的族人曾（奉为神圣/consecrate）的神龛。那些证词没有（押头韵般/alliterate）流于轻巧的诗意；它们生涩、（参差不一/disparate)，也正因如此更显可信。

并非人人都配合。元帅死忠中一个（怙恶不悛的/unregenerate）小集团起身（猛烈抨击/fulminate）这场审理、（谩骂痛斥/vituperate）委员们是叛徒、（深恶痛绝/abominate）这整桩活动是一场作秀公审。他们试图把互不相干的怨情（串连拼接/concatenate）成一股单一、（混沌初成的/inchoate）怒火、（夸大/exaggerate）代价、（诋毁/denigrate）动机。一位前（巨头大亨/magnate)，一个靠这个政权的赃物发了财的（忘恩负义之徒/ingrate)，（指定自封/designate）自己为受冤者的代言人——一个被证据迅速（剖空摧毁/eviscerate）的（不正当/illegitimate）主张。他（愤怒地/irate）离开了议事厅，什么也没（佐证/corroborate）成。

听证会之外，这个共和国寻常的工作仍在继续。诊所给年幼者（接种疫苗/vaccinate)、照料每一个脆弱的（新生儿/neonate)；农夫们为正在复苏的田地（授粉/pollinate)、（透气松土/aerate）、（补水灌溉/hydrate)；一代只知道元帅那（脱水干瘪的/dehydrate）宣传的人，如今学着为自己（反复思量/ruminate)。合作社（聚结成团/agglomerate）为一个由小生产者组成的坚实（联合企业集团/conglomerate)；这个经济不再野蛮地（激增繁衍/proliferate)，而是增长到足以（酬报/remunerate）诚实的劳动、（重振焕新/rejuvenate）那些久遭忽视的省份。再没有人需要仅仅为了吃饭而（移居外迁/emigrate)。

委员会的最终报告，将不会是那（完满至臻的/consummate）、盖棺定论的最后定论——这样的东西并不存在。它将（略加勾勒/adumbrate）每一处细节、而非（详尽阐述/elaborate)，把这项工作留给后来的史学家去（反复进行/iterate）和（重申再做/reiterate)。它拒绝把过往（监禁囚禁/incarcerate）进一个盖棺定论的单一（板条箱/crate）里。它的作者们知道，让一种真相（压倒占优/preponderate）于所有其他真相之上，本身便会（掺假篡改/adulterate）这份记录。他们转而奉上一份诚实的、（倒数第二稿的/penultimate）草稿——一个仍在书写之中的故事。

于是韦尔莫利亚并不为它的坦诚而（敬重自夸/venerate）自己，也不为它的过失而（痛斥/execrate）自己。元帅曾力图把记忆（连根拔除/deracinate)、（支配主宰/dominate）过往；他的国家，二十年后，选择了那个更艰难、更（富有同情心的/compassionate）的路径：（照亮阐明/illuminate）所发生之事、为它（佐证印证/corroborate)、并让一个自由、（识字开化/literate)、自我治理的民族，自行决定铭记什么、宽恕什么。委员们的结论是：向往真相的本能不是习得的，而是（与生俱来的/innate）——而它，到头来，是唯一一份没有哪个暴君能够（消灭根除/exterminate）的遗产。

本批词根亮点：

• -ate 大家族终极篇：consummate/proximate/approximate/intimate，全来自拉丁 -atus 过去分词后缀，名词/形容词/动词三用

• vaccinate：来自拉丁 vacca（母牛），爱德华·詹纳用牛痘预防天花，vaccine=牛的=疫苗，cow/bovine 同根

• fulminate：fulmen（闪电），像雷电一样猛烈抗议，fulminant（爆发性的）同根

• inchoate：in+choate（开始），刚开始还不完整的=初步的，拉丁 incohare=开始耕地

• procrastinate：pro（向前）+ cras（明天），一直推到明天=拖延，procrastination=拖延症

• ruminate：rumen（反刍胃），像牛反刍一样=沉思，ruminant（反刍动物）同根

• decimate：deci（十分之一），每十人杀一人的古罗马军法=大量毁灭，decimal/decade 同根

• emancipate：e+mancipate（手持/所有权），从所有权中解放=解放，manuscript（手写）同根

quiz.question: primate _______
quiz.explanation: 灵长类动物，灵长类动物物种。Scientists have identified over 500 primate species in tropical forests. 科学家已确认热带森林中500多种灵长类动物物种。 | primus->第一（拉丁），primate->第一等的动物=灵长类（cf. prime首要，primary主要，premier首相，primacy首位，primate大主教） || 文化联想：川金丝猴是中国最有代表性的灵长类动物之一，最适合帮助记忆 primate，可以说 **a primate species — “The golden snub-nosed monkey is a primate species native to the mountain forests of central China.”**

quiz.question: legitimate _____
quiz.explanation: 合法的，合法的要求。The plaintiff presented evidence to support his legitimate claim. 原告提出证据支持他的合法要求。 | leg->法律（拉丁lex），legitimate->符合法律的=合法的（cf. legal合法，legislature立法机关，illegitimate非法，legislation法规） || 文化联想：中文“合情合理、依法有据”最适合帮助记忆 legitimate，可以说 **a legitimate claim — “A request supported by both evidence and law can be treated as a legitimate claim.”**

quiz.question: illegitimate _____
quiz.explanation: 私生的，私生子。In medieval times, an illegitimate child had no rights to inheritance. 在中世纪，私生子没有继承权。 | il->否定，legitimate->合法的，illegitimate->不合法的（cf. legitimate合法，illegal非法，legitimize合法化，bastard私生子） || 文化联想：传统宗族社会会严格区分婚生与非婚生子女的身份，这种历史背景可帮助理解 illegitimate，可以说 **an illegitimate child — “In older legal and family systems, an illegitimate child could face restrictions that did not apply to a child born within a recognized marriage.”**

quiz.question: penultimate _______
quiz.explanation: 倒数第二的，倒数第二章。The penultimate chapter revealed the murderer's identity. 倒数第二章揭示了凶手的身份。 | pen->几乎（拉丁paene），ultimate->最后，penultimate->几乎是最后的=倒数第二（cf. peninsula半岛=几乎是岛，penumbra半影，penury贫困） || 文化联想：章回小说读到最后两回时，倒数第二回就是 penultimate chapter，可以说 **the penultimate chapter — “In a hundred-chapter novel, Chapter 99 is the penultimate chapter, immediately before the ending.”**

quiz.question: intimate ______
quiz.explanation: 亲密的，亲密的朋友。She confided her deepest secrets only to her most intimate friend. 她只向最亲密的朋友吐露最深的秘密。 | intimus->最内部的（拉丁），intimate->最内部的=亲密的（cf. interior内部，internal内部，intimacy亲密，intimidate恐吓=进入内部） || 文化联想：中文“知己”最适合帮助记忆 intimate friend，可以说 **an intimate friend — “A true 知己 is an intimate friend with whom one can share thoughts that are kept from almost everyone else.”**

quiz.question: proximate _____
quiz.explanation: 最接近的，近因。The investigation identified driver negligence as the proximate cause of the accident. 调查确定驾驶员疏忽是事故的近因。 | proxim->近（拉丁proximus），proximate->最近的（cf. proximity接近，approximate大约，approximately大约，next下一个） || 文化联想：查事故时常要区分背景因素和直接导致事故发生的近因，最适合联想到 proximate，可以说 **the proximate cause — “If a driver runs a red light and immediately causes a collision, that violation may be identified as the proximate cause of the crash.”**

quiz.question: approximate _____
quiz.explanation: 大约的，近似值。The surveyor could only provide an approximate value for the land. 测量员只能提供该土地的近似值。 | ap->朝向，proxim->近，approximate->朝近处=大约的（cf. proximate最近的，proximity接近，approximation近似值，rough粗略） || 文化联想：中文“八九不离十”最适合帮助记忆 approximate，可以说 **an approximate value — “An estimate described as ‘八九不离十’ gives an approximate value that is close to the true figure without being exact.”**

quiz.question: consummate ____________
quiz.explanation: 完美的，完美的专业人士。Her dedication made her a consummate professional. 她的奉献精神使她成为完美的专业人士。 | con->完全，summ->最高（拉丁summus），consummate->达到最高点=完美的（cf. summit顶峰，sum总和，consummation完成，assume假设） || 文化联想：中文“炉火纯青”形容技艺已经达到极高境界，最适合联想到 consummate，可以说 **a consummate professional — “A master craftsman whose skill has reached ‘炉火纯青’ can be regarded as a consummate professional.”**

quiz.question: alienate __________
quiz.explanation: 疏远，疏远支持者。The politician's remarks threatened to alienate supporters. 政客的言论威胁要疏远支持者。 | alien->外来的（拉丁alienus->他人的），alienate->使变成外来人=疏远（cf. alien外星人，alienation疏离，inalienable不可剥夺） || 文化联想：中文“众叛亲离”最适合帮助记忆 alienate，可以说 **alienate one’s supporters — “An arrogant leader who repeatedly ignores loyal followers may gradually alienate his supporters until even old allies leave.”**

quiz.question: concatenate _______
quiz.explanation: 连接，连接字符串。The program needs to concatenate strings from multiple sources. 该程序需要将来自多个来源的字符串连接成一个输出。 | con->共同，caten->链（拉丁catena），concatenate->链接在一起（cf. chain链，catenary悬链线，concatenation连接，enchained被锁链） || 文化联想：中文姓名数据库里常要把姓和名两个字符串连接起来，最适合联想到 concatenate，可以说 **concatenate two strings — “A program can concatenate the surname ‘王’ and the given name ‘小明’ to produce the full name ‘王小明.’”**

quiz.question: rejuvenate ____
quiz.explanation: 使恢复活力，使皮肤恢复活力。The new moisturizer claims to rejuvenate skin. 这款新保湿霜声称能使皮肤恢复活力。 | re->再次，juven->年轻（拉丁juvenis），rejuvenate->使再次年轻=恢复活力（cf. juvenile青少年，junior年轻，youth青春，rejuvenation复兴） || 文化联想：中文“返老还童”最适合帮助记忆 rejuvenate，可以说 **rejuvenate the skin — “A skincare advertisement may promise to rejuvenate the skin and make it look fresher and more youthful.”**

quiz.question: ________ magnate
quiz.explanation: 巨头，商业巨头。The business magnate donated millions to charitable causes. 商业巨头向慈善事业捐赠了数百万美元。 | magn->大（拉丁magnus），magnate->权贵大人物（cf. magnificent宏伟，magnify放大，magnitude量级，magnanimous宽宏大量） || 文化联想：晋商、徽商中拥有巨大财富和商业网络的大商人很适合联想到 magnate，可以说 **a business magnate — “A wealthy salt merchant with influence across several provinces could become a business magnate of his era.”**

quiz.question: designate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 指定，指定继任者。The retiring CEO needed to designate a successor. 即将退休的首席执行官需要指定继任者。 | de->彻底，sign->标记（拉丁signum），designate->标记指定（cf. design设计，signal信号，signature签名，assign分配，resign辞职） || 文化联想：古代皇帝正式立太子，就是最典型的指定继承人场景，可以说 **designate a successor — “An emperor could designate a successor by formally naming one of his sons crown prince.”**

quiz.question: cognate ________
quiz.explanation: 同源的，同源语言。Spanish and Italian are cognate language sharing many common roots. 西班牙语和意大利语是同源语言有许多共同词根。 | co->共同，gnat->出生（拉丁natus），cognate->共同出生=同源的（cf. nature自然，native本地，nascent新生，innate天生，pregnant怀孕） || 文化联想：汉语各方言中很多词虽然读音已经不同，却能追溯到共同来源，很适合联想到 cognate，可以说 **cognate forms — “Mandarin and Cantonese contain many cognate forms that descend from earlier stages of Chinese despite major differences in pronunciation.”**

quiz.question: deracinate _________
quiz.explanation: 根除，根除传统。Rapid modernization threatened to deracinate tradition that had lasted centuries. 快速现代化威胁要根除持续了几个世纪的传统。 | de->去除，racin->根（法语racine），deracinate->连根拔起=根除（cf. radical根本，radish萝卜，eradicate根除，uproot根除） || 文化联想：中文“连根拔起”几乎就是 deracinate 的字面画面，可以说 **deracinate a tradition — “Rapid social change can deracinate a local tradition if the community that once sustained it disappears.”**

quiz.question: vaccinate ________
quiz.explanation: 接种疫苗，给儿童接种疫苗。Health officials urged parents to vaccinate children. 卫生官员敦促父母给儿童接种疫苗。 | vacca->母牛（拉丁），vaccinate->用牛痘接种（詹纳用牛痘预防天花，cf. vaccine疫苗，bovine牛的，cow牛，vaccination接种） || 文化联想：中国儿童按免疫程序接种疫苗是最直观的 vaccinate 场景，可以说 **vaccinate children — “Community clinics routinely vaccinate children against preventable infectious diseases according to the immunization schedule.”**

quiz.question: fascinate ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 使着迷，使观众着迷。The magician's tricks continued to fascinate the audience. 魔术师的戏法继续使观众着迷。 | fascinum->魔咒（拉丁），fascinate->施加魔咒=使着迷（cf. fascism法西斯=束棒象征，fascination迷恋，captivate迷住） || 文化联想：川剧变脸瞬间切换脸谱的表演很容易让观众着迷，最适合联想到 fascinate，可以说 **fascinate the audience — “The rapid face-changing technique of Sichuan opera can fascinate the audience because each transformation seems almost instantaneous.”**

quiz.question: insubordinate ________
quiz.explanation: 不服从的，不服从的员工。The manager had no choice but to discipline the insubordinate employee. 经理别无选择只能惩戒不服从的员工。 | in->否定，sub->在下，ordin->命令（拉丁），insubordinate->不在命令之下=不服从的（cf. subordinate下属，ordinate坐标，ordain任命） || 文化联想：军营里公然抗命、不服从指挥的士兵最适合联想到 insubordinate，可以说 **an insubordinate soldier — “A soldier who openly refuses a lawful order may be disciplined as an insubordinate member of the unit.”**

quiz.question: inordinate _____
quiz.explanation: 过度的，过度的延误。The project suffered from inordinate delay due to bureaucratic obstacles. 项目因官僚障碍遭受了过度延误。 | in->否定，ordin->有序（拉丁ordinatus），inordinate->失去秩序的=过度的（cf. order秩序，ordinary普通，orderly有序，coordinate协调） || 文化联想：中文“拖得没完没了”很适合帮助记忆 inordinate，可以说 **an inordinate delay — “A permit that should take days but remains stuck for months has suffered an inordinate delay.”**

quiz.question: pollinate _______
quiz.explanation: 授粉，给花授粉。Bees play a crucial role in helping to pollinate flowers. 蜜蜂在帮助花授粉方面发挥至关重要的作用。 | pollen->花粉（拉丁），pollinate->传播花粉=授粉（cf. pollen花粉，pollinators授粉者，cross-pollination异花授粉） || 文化联想：果园里蜜蜂在花间飞舞、帮助苹果或梨树授粉，最适合联想到 pollinate，可以说 **pollinate the flowers — “Bees moving through an orchard help pollinate the flowers so that the trees can later produce fruit.”**

quiz.question: laminate ________
quiz.explanation: 层压的，层压地板。The homeowners chose durable laminate flooring for the kitchen renovation. 房主为厨房翻新选择了耐用的层压地板。 | lamina->薄板（拉丁），laminate->用薄板层叠=层压的（cf. lamina薄层，laminated层压的，layer层，veneer贴面） || 文化联想：中国家庭装修里常见强化复合地板，最适合帮助记忆 laminate，可以说 **laminate flooring — “Many apartment renovations use laminate flooring because it is easy to install and resembles wood at lower cost.”**

quiz.question: effeminate ______
quiz.explanation: 女性化的，女性化的举止。Critics unfairly described his gentle speech as an effeminate manner. 批评者不公平地将他温和的言谈描述为女性化的举止。 | ef->使，femin->女性（拉丁femina），effeminate->使像女性=女性化的（cf. feminine女性，feminism女权，female女性，femme女性） || 文化联想：旧社会常把男性温柔文弱的举止贴上“脂粉气”的标签，这种带刻板色彩的评价可帮助理解 effeminate，可以说 **an effeminate manner — “Traditional critics might unfairly describe a gentle or delicate male manner as effeminate simply because it did not match conventional ideals of masculinity.”**

quiz.question: disseminate ____
quiz.explanation: 传播，传播信息。Social media platforms can rapidly disseminate info to millions. 社交媒体平台可以迅速向数百万用户传播信息。 | dis->分散，semin->种子（拉丁semen），disseminate->像撒种子一样传播（cf. semen种子，seminary神学院=播种处，seminal开创性的） || 文化联想：古代邸报把朝廷消息传往各地，是很好的 disseminate 记忆钩子，可以说 **disseminate information — “Official bulletins helped disseminate information from the court to officials in distant regions.”**

quiz.question: eliminate _____
quiz.explanation: 消除，消除浪费。The company implemented lean manufacturing to eliminate waste. 公司实施精益生产以消除浪费。 | e->向外，limin->门槛（拉丁limen），eliminate->把...推出门槛外=消除（cf. preliminary预备=在门槛前，subliminal潜意识，liminal过渡的） || 文化联想：“光盘行动”强调减少餐桌浪费，最适合帮助记忆 eliminate，可以说 **eliminate food waste — “The ‘Clean Plate’ campaign encourages diners to order sensibly and eliminate unnecessary food waste.”**

quiz.question: discriminate _______
quiz.explanation: 歧视，歧视。It is illegal for employers to discriminate against applicants based on age. 雇主基于年龄歧视申请人是非法的。 | dis->分开，crimin->分辨（拉丁discernere），discriminate->分辨=区分/歧视（cf. crime犯罪，criminal罪犯，discern辨别，criterion标准） || 文化联想：传统“重男轻女”观念会造成对女孩和女性的不公平区别对待，最适合联想到 discriminate，可以说 **discriminate against women — “A rule that favors sons simply because they are male can discriminate against women and girls.”**

quiz.question: fulminate _______
quiz.explanation: 强烈抗议，强烈抗议。The senator took to the floor to fulminate against the proposed legislation. 参议员走上讲台强烈抗议拟议的立法。 | fulmen->闪电（拉丁），fulminate->像闪电般猛烈抗议（cf. fulminant爆发性的，thunder雷，lightning闪电，fulmination猛烈谴责） || 文化联想：海瑞上疏时以极其激烈的言辞批评朝政，很适合联想到 fulminate，可以说 **fulminate against corruption — “An outspoken censor might fulminate against corruption in a memorial filled with fierce moral condemnation.”**

quiz.question: abominate _______
quiz.explanation: 憎恶，憎恶残忍。People of conscience abominate cruelty toward animals. 有良知的人憎恶对动物的残忍。 | ab->离开，omin->预兆（拉丁omen），abominate->视为不吉预兆=憎恶（cf. omen预兆，ominous不祥，abominable可憎，abomination憎恶） || 文化联想：孟子所说的“恻隐之心”强调人应厌恶残忍、同情受苦者，很适合联想到 abominate，可以说 **abominate cruelty — “A person guided by compassion may abominate cruelty toward people or animals.”**

quiz.question: dominate ______
quiz.explanation: 主导，主导市场。The tech giant continued to dominate market share. 科技巨头继续主导市场份额。 | domin->主人（拉丁dominus），dominate->成为主人=主导（cf. domain领域，dominant主导，dominion统治，domineering专横，dominoes多米诺） || 文化联想：明清时期中国瓷器在许多海外市场极具影响力，可以帮助记忆 dominate，可以说 **dominate a market — “For long periods, Chinese porcelain helped dominate important segments of the international luxury ceramics market.”**

quiz.question: predominate __
quiz.explanation: 占主导地位，占主导地位于。Traditional values still predominate in rural communities. 传统价值观在农村社区仍占主导地位。 | pre->之前，dominate->主导，predominate->在前方主导=占优势（cf. dominant主导，dominate主导，preeminent杰出，prevail盛行） || 文化联想：春节装饰里红色往往占据最显眼的位置，最适合联想到 predominate，可以说 **red predominates — “During the Spring Festival, red often predominates in lanterns, couplets, envelopes, and other decorations.”**

quiz.question: nominate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 提名，提名候选人。The committee will meet to nominate a candidate for the position. 委员会将开会为该职位提名候选人。 | nomin->名字（拉丁nomen），nominate->用名字指定=提名（cf. name名字，noun名词，denomination命名，nominal名义上的） || 文化联想：现代协会或委员会开会推举候选人，就是 nominate 的典型场景，可以说 **nominate a candidate — “A committee may nominate a candidate for chair before the members vote.”**

quiz.question: denominate ________
quiz.explanation: 以...计价的货币，以...计价的货币。International bonds are often denominate currency in US dollars. 国际债券通常以美元计价。 | de->彻底，nomin->名字，denominate->命名=以...计价（cf. nominate提名，name名字，denomination面额/教派，noun名词） || 文化联想：以人民币计价的债券最适合帮助记忆 denominate，可以说 **a renminbi-denominated bond — “An overseas issuer may sell a renminbi-denominated bond whose principal and interest are stated in Chinese currency.”**

quiz.question: _____ germinate
quiz.explanation: 发芽，种子发芽。Given proper moisture and warmth, seeds germinate within a few days. 在适当的湿度和温度下，种子会在几天内发芽。 | germen->胚芽（拉丁），germinate->胚芽生长=发芽（cf. germ细菌/胚芽，Germany德国，germane相关，germinal最初的） || 文化联想：春耕时稻种浸水催芽、冒出小白芽的画面最适合帮助记忆 germinate，可以说 **seeds germinate — “After rice seeds are soaked and kept warm, the seeds germinate and send out tiny shoots.”**

quiz.question: indeterminate ____
quiz.explanation: 不确定的，不确定的期限。The contract specified an indeterminate term subject to annual review. 合同规定了一个不确定的需年度审查的期限。 | in->否定，determin->确定（拉丁determinare），indeterminate->无法确定的（cf. determine决定，terminal终端，exterminate消灭，terminus终点） || 文化联想：中文“期限未定”最适合帮助记忆 indeterminate，可以说 **an indeterminate term — “An arrangement with no fixed end date may continue for an indeterminate term until either side changes it.”**

quiz.question: exterminate _____
quiz.explanation: 消灭，消灭害虫。The farmer hired professionals to exterminate pests. 农民雇佣专业人员消灭害虫。 | ex->向外，termin->终结（拉丁terminus），exterminate->驱出使终结=消灭（cf. terminate终止，terminal终端，determination决心，interminable无休止） || 文化联想：农村请专业人员彻底消灭白蚁、蟑螂等害虫，最适合联想到 exterminate，可以说 **exterminate pests — “A serious termite infestation may require professionals to exterminate the pests before they damage the wooden structure.”**

quiz.question: illuminate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 照亮，照亮道路。Street lamps were installed to illuminate the path through the park. 安装了路灯以在夜间照亮穿过公园的道路。 | il->使，lumin->光（拉丁lumen），illuminate->使有光=照亮（cf. luminous发光，luminary名人，lumen流明，pellucid清澈=透光） || 文化联想：元宵灯笼照亮夜路的画面最适合帮助记忆 illuminate，可以说 **illuminate the path — “Rows of lanterns can illuminate the path through a temple fair after sunset.”**

quiz.question: ruminate __
quiz.explanation: 沉思，沉思于。The philosopher would ruminate on questions of existence for hours. 哲学家会沉思存在的问题数小时。 | rumen->反刍胃（拉丁），ruminate->像牛反刍一样深思（cf. ruminant反刍动物，chew反复咀嚼，ponder深思，muse沉思，rumination沉思） || 文化联想：古人反复咀嚼《论语》一句话、越想越有味道，最适合联想到 ruminate，可以说 **ruminate on a saying — “A student may ruminate on a short saying from the Analects and discover new meaning each time it is reconsidered.”**

quiz.question: indoctrinate _____
quiz.explanation: 灌输，向青年灌输。The regime used schools to indoctrinate youth with propaganda. 政权利用学校向青年灌输宣传。 | in->进入，doctr->教义（拉丁doctrina），indoctrinate->灌输教义（cf. doctrine教义，doctor博士，docile温顺，document文件） || 文化联想：如果学校只允许一种政治或思想答案、不准独立质疑，就很适合联想到 indoctrinate，可以说 **indoctrinate the young — “A system that forces students to repeat one approved ideology without questioning it is trying to indoctrinate the young.”**

quiz.question: procrastinate ____
quiz.explanation: 拖延，拖延工作。Students who procrastinate work often face stress as deadlines approach. 拖延工作的学生在截止日期临近时常面临压力。 | pro->向前，cras->明天（拉丁），procrastinate->一直推到明天=拖延（cf. procrastination拖延症，delay推迟，defer推迟，cras=tomorrow） || 文化联想：《明日歌》“明日复明日，明日何其多”是 procrastinate 的最佳中国记忆钩子，可以说 **procrastinate on one’s work — “The warning ‘tomorrow after tomorrow’ captures what happens when someone keeps procrastinating on work that should be done today.”**

quiz.question: innate _______
quiz.explanation: 天生的，天生的能力。Mozart demonstrated innate ability for music from an early age. 莫扎特从小就展示了天生的音乐能力。 | in->在内，nat->出生（拉丁natus），innate->出生时就有的=天生的（cf. nature自然，native本地，natal出生，cognate同源，pregnancy怀孕） || 文化联想：李白“天生我材必有用”最适合帮助记忆 innate，可以说 **an innate ability — “The line ‘Heaven gave me talents for a purpose’ evokes the idea of an innate ability that a person possesses from birth.”**

quiz.question: neonate ____
quiz.explanation: 新生儿，新生儿护理。The hospital's specialized unit provides intensive neonate care. 医院的专科部门提供重症新生儿护理。 | neo->新（希腊），nat->出生，neonate->新出生的=新生儿（cf. neonatal新生儿的，natal出生，prenatal产前，postnatal产后） || 文化联想：中国人说“月子里的新生儿”时，出生最初几周的宝宝正属于 neonate，可以说 **neonate care — “A premature or medically fragile baby may need specialized neonate care during the first weeks after birth.”**

quiz.question: passionate ____
quiz.explanation: 热情的，热情的吻。The romantic scene ended with a passionate kiss. 浪漫场景以热情的吻结束。 | passion->激情（拉丁passio->受苦），passionate->充满激情的（cf. compassion同情，dispassionate冷静，impassioned充满激情，patient忍耐=受苦） || 文化联想：现代七夕爱情电影里久别重逢的一对恋人热烈亲吻，很适合帮助记忆 passionate，可以说 **a passionate kiss — “In a modern Qixi romance, a long-separated couple may reunite with a passionate kiss.”**

quiz.question: compassionate _____
quiz.explanation: 同情的，同情假。The company granted her compassionate leave to care for her ailing mother. 公司批准了同情假以让她照顾生病的母亲。 | com->共同，passion->受苦，compassionate->共同受苦=同情的（cf. passion激情，compassion同情，patient忍耐，dispassionate冷静） || 文化联想：现代公司允许员工请假照顾重病父母，就是 compassionate leave 的典型场景，可以说 **compassionate leave — “An employee may receive compassionate leave to care for a seriously ill parent.”**

quiz.question: dispassionate ________
quiz.explanation: 冷静的，冷静的分析。The judge provided a dispassionate analysis of the evidence. 法官对证据进行了冷静的分析。 | dis->去除，passion->激情，dispassionate->去除激情的=冷静的（cf. passionate热情，compassionate同情，impartial公正，objective客观） || 文化联想：包公“铁面无私”的文化形象强调审案时不受私人感情影响，很适合联想到 dispassionate，可以说 **a dispassionate analysis — “An ideal judge in the tradition of Bao Zheng should give a dispassionate analysis of the evidence rather than favor friends or the powerful.”**

quiz.question: impersonate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 模仿，模仿名人。The comedian's ability to impersonate a celebrity made him famous. 喜剧演员模仿名人的能力使他成名。 | im->使，person->人（拉丁persona->面具），impersonate->充当他人=模仿（cf. person人，personality个性，personify拟人化，persona角色） || 文化联想：综艺节目里喜剧演员模仿明星的声音和动作，最适合帮助记忆 impersonate，可以说 **impersonate a celebrity — “A comedian on a variety show may impersonate a celebrity by copying the person’s voice, expressions, and gestures.”**

quiz.question: detonate _ ____
quiz.explanation: 引爆，引爆炸弹。The bomb squad carefully worked to detonate a bomb. 拆弹小组小心翼翼地引爆炸弹。 | de->向下，ton->雷鸣（拉丁tonare），detonate->使雷鸣=引爆（cf. thunder雷，tonic音调，tone音调，detonation爆炸，detonator雷管） || 文化联想：拆弹人员把危险爆炸物转移到安全区域后进行受控引爆，可以帮助记忆 detonate，可以说 **detonate a bomb safely — “A bomb-disposal team may move an explosive device to a controlled site and detonate it safely away from the public.”**

quiz.question: ____ incarnate
quiz.explanation: 化身，邪恶的化身。The villain in the story was portrayed as evil incarnate. 故事中的反派被描绘为邪恶的化身。 | in->进入，carn->肉（拉丁caro），incarnate->进入肉身=化身（cf. carnage大屠杀，carnival嘉年华=肉的节日，carnal肉体的，reincarnation转世） || 文化联想：《西游记》里的白骨精常被塑造成阴险邪恶的妖怪形象，很适合联想到 incarnate，可以说 **evil incarnate — “In a dramatic retelling of Journey to the West, the White Bone Demon may be portrayed as evil incarnate.”**

quiz.question: reincarnate ____
quiz.explanation: 转世，转世的灵魂。Many religions believe that the soul will reincarnate in a new body. 许多宗教相信灵魂会在新的身体中转世。 | re->再次，in->进入，carn->肉，reincarnate->再次进入肉身=转世（cf. incarnate化身，carnival嘉年华，carnal肉体的） || 文化联想：佛教和民间信仰中的“轮回转世”最适合帮助记忆 reincarnate，可以说 **reincarnate in another body — “Traditional beliefs about rebirth hold that a soul or consciousness may reincarnate in another body after death.”**

quiz.question: alternate ______
quiz.explanation: 替代的，替代路线。The GPS suggested alternate routes to avoid heavy traffic. GPS建议替代路线以避开拥堵的交通。 | alter->另一个（拉丁alter），alternate->交替的另一个=替代的（cf. alter改变，alternative替代，altercation争吵，altruism利他主义） || 文化联想：山路塌方时导航会提示改走备用路线，最适合联想到 alternate，可以说 **an alternate route — “If a mountain road is closed by a landslide, drivers may take an alternate route through a neighboring valley.”**

quiz.question: inchoate ____
quiz.explanation: 初步的，初步的计划。The startup presented only an inchoate plan to potential investors. 初创公司只向潜在投资者展示了初步的计划。 | in->开始，choate->耕地（拉丁inchoare->开始），inchoate->刚刚开始未完成的=初步的（cf. nascent新生，embryonic萌芽状态，rudimentary基本的） || 文化联想：中文“还只是个雏形”最适合帮助记忆 inchoate，可以说 **an inchoate plan — “A proposal that has only a rough goal and no budget, schedule, or details is still an inchoate plan.”**

quiz.question: emancipate ______
quiz.explanation: 解放，解放奴隶。Abraham Lincoln issued a proclamation to emancipate slaves. 林肯发布了解放奴隶的公告。 | e->向外，mancip->手持所有权（拉丁manus+capere），emancipate->从所有权中解放（cf. manuscript手稿，manacle手铐，emancipation解放，manumit释放奴隶） || 文化联想：中国历史课讲美国内战时常会学到林肯解放黑奴，这个熟悉课堂语境可帮助记忆 emancipate，可以说 **emancipate enslaved people — “In Chinese history classes, students learn that Lincoln’s wartime policy aimed to emancipate enslaved people in the rebelling states.”**

quiz.question: dissipate ____
quiz.explanation: 消散，消散热量。The cooling system works efficiently to dissipate heat from the engine. 冷却系统有效地消散发动机产生的热量。 | dis->分散，sip->投掷（拉丁sipare），dissipate->分散投出=消散（cf. dissipation消散/放荡，dispel驱散，dissipated放荡的） || 文化联想：手机或电脑运行久了必须靠散热片和风扇把热量散出去，最适合联想到 dissipate，可以说 **dissipate heat — “A laptop’s cooling system uses fans and heat sinks to dissipate heat produced by the processor.”**

quiz.question: inculpate _______
quiz.explanation: 控告，控告嫌疑人。The new evidence served to inculpate suspect in the robbery. 新证据有助于控告抢劫案的嫌疑人。 | in->使，culp->罪（拉丁culpa），inculpate->归罪于=控告（cf. culpable有罪，exculpate开脱，mea culpa我的过失，culprit罪犯） || 文化联想：包公断案故事里新证据若把嫌疑人和罪行联系起来，就最适合联想到 inculpate，可以说 **inculpate a suspect — “A newly discovered ledger or witness statement may inculpate a suspect by linking him directly to the crime.”**

quiz.question: exculpate ___ _________
quiz.explanation: 开脱，为被告开脱。The defense attorney presented evidence to exculpate the defendant. 辩护律师提出证据为被告开脱。 | ex->向外，culp->罪，exculpate->消除罪责=开脱（cf. inculpate归罪，culpable有罪，mea culpa我的过失，exonerate免罪） || 文化联想：中文“洗清冤屈”最适合帮助记忆 exculpate，可以说 **exculpate the accused — “New evidence that proves a person could not have committed the crime may exculpate the accused and clear his name.”**

quiz.question: separate ________
quiz.explanation: 分开的，分开的账户。The couple maintained separate accounts after getting married. 这对夫妇结婚后保持分开的账户。 | se->分开，par->准备（拉丁parare），separate->分开准备=分开的（cf. preparate准备，repair修复，part部分，apart分开） || 文化联想：现代夫妻婚后各自保留独立银行账户，是 separate 最直观的场景之一，可以说 **separate accounts — “Some married couples choose to keep separate accounts while sharing household expenses.”**

quiz.question: disparate ________
quiz.explanation: 迥异的，迥异的结果。The study revealed disparate outcomes for different demographic groups. 研究揭示了不同人口群体的迥异结果。 | dis->否定，par->相等（拉丁par），disparate->不相等的=迥异的（cf. parity平等，disparity差距，compare比较，separate分开） || 文化联想：同一场暴雨对山区和城市可能造成完全不同的结果，很适合联想到 disparate，可以说 **disparate outcomes — “The same storm can produce disparate outcomes, causing landslides in mountain villages but only minor flooding elsewhere.”**

quiz.question: adumbrate _ ____
quiz.explanation: 勾画，勾画计划。The executive meeting served to adumbrate a plan for expansion. 高管会议用来勾画扩张计划。 | ad->朝向，umbr->阴影（拉丁umbra），adumbrate->用阴影勾画=概略描述（cf. umbrella雨伞=小阴影，penumbra半影，umbrage不快=被阴影笼罩） || 文化联想：中国画正式落墨前常先轻轻勾勒山水的大致轮廓，最适合联想到 adumbrate，可以说 **adumbrate a composition — “Before adding ink washes, a painter may adumbrate the composition with a few faint lines showing mountains, trees, and figures.”**

quiz.question: _______ lucubrate
quiz.explanation: 刻苦研究，每夜刻苦研究。The dedicated scholar would nightly lucubrate over ancient manuscripts. 专注的学者每夜都会刻苦研究古代手稿。 | luc->光（拉丁lux），lubrat->工作，lucubrate->在灯光下工作=刻苦研读（cf. lucid清晰，illuminate照亮，translucent半透明，lucent发光） || 文化联想：“囊萤夜读”最适合帮助记忆 lucubrate，因为它正是夜间借微光苦读的形象，可以说 **lucubrate late into the night — “The story of studying by the light of fireflies evokes a scholar who would lucubrate late into the night despite poor conditions.”**

quiz.question: ______ crate
quiz.explanation: 板条箱，木板条箱。The fragile items were packed carefully in a wooden crate. 易碎物品被小心地装在木板条箱里。 | crate->板条箱（荷兰语krat->格子架），crate->运输用板条箱（cf. grate格栅，grater磨碎器，crate板条箱，cager篮球运动员） || 文化联想：景德镇瓷器远途运输时常需要装进结实木箱，最适合帮助记忆 crate，可以说 **a wooden crate — “Fragile porcelain for a long journey may be packed inside a padded wooden crate.”**

quiz.question: desecrate _ ______
quiz.explanation: 亵渎，亵渎圣地。Vandals attempted to desecrate a shrine sacred to the local community. 破坏者试图亵渎当地社区的圣地。 | de->去除，sacr->神圣（拉丁sacer），desecrate->去除神圣性=亵渎（cf. sacred神圣，consecrate奉献，sacrifice牺牲，sacrilege亵渎） || 文化联想：砸毁祖祠牌位、污损神龛在传统社会会被视为严重亵渎，最适合联想到 desecrate，可以说 **desecrate a shrine — “Vandalizing ancestral tablets or sacred images would desecrate a shrine that a community treats with reverence.”**

quiz.question: consecrate ______
quiz.explanation: 使神圣，使土地神圣。The bishop arrived to consecrate ground for the new church. 主教前来使新教堂的土地神圣化。 | con->共同/加强，sacr->神圣，consecrate->使完全神圣（cf. sacred神圣，desecrate亵渎，sacrifice牺牲，sacrosanct神圣不可侵犯） || 文化联想：consecrate 本身更常用于基督教语境，可以用中国境内新建教堂举行祝圣仪式来记忆，可以说 **consecrate the ground — “Before construction of a new church in China, clergy may hold a ceremony to consecrate the ground.”**

quiz.question: execrate _______
quiz.explanation: 咒骂，咒骂暴政。Freedom fighters gathered to execrate tyranny and oppression. 自由战士聚集咒骂暴政和压迫。 | ex->向外，secr->神圣（拉丁sacer），execrate->驱出神圣范围=咒骂（cf. execrable极坏，sacred神圣，consecrate奉献，desecrate亵渎） || 文化联想：“苛政猛于虎”表达了对残酷统治的强烈谴责，最适合联想到 execrate，可以说 **execrate tyranny — “Someone who remembers the warning that harsh government can be fiercer than a tiger may execrate tyranny and oppression.”**

quiz.question: hydrate ____
quiz.explanation: 使水合，使皮肤水合。Drinking plenty of water helps hydrate skin from within. 喝大量的水有助于从内部使皮肤水合。 | hydr->水（希腊hydor），hydrate->使含水=水合（cf. hydrogen氢=产水，hydraulic液压，dehydrate脱水，carbohydrate碳水化合物） || 文化联想：北方冬天室内干燥，很多人会用保湿霜给皮肤补水，最适合联想到 hydrate，可以说 **hydrate the skin — “During a dry northern winter, moisturizer helps hydrate the skin and reduce tightness and flaking.”**

quiz.question: dehydrate _____
quiz.explanation: 使脱水，使水果脱水。The machine can dehydrate fruit to create healthy snacks. 这台机器可以使水果脱水以制作健康零食。 | de->去除，hydr->水，dehydrate->去除水分=脱水（cf. hydrate水合，rehydrate补水，drought干旱，desiccate使干燥） || 文化联想：新疆葡萄晾成葡萄干就是最典型的 dehydrate 场景，可以说 **dehydrate fruit — “Warm, dry air in Xinjiang can dehydrate grapes until they become sweet raisins.”**

quiz.question: _______ carbohydrate
quiz.explanation: 碳水化合物，膳食碳水化合物。Athletes need adequate dietary carbohydrate for energy during training. 运动员在训练期间需要足够的膳食碳水化合物获得能量。 | carbo->碳，hydr->水，carbohydrate->碳与水的化合物（cf. carbon碳，hydrogen氢，hydrate水合，glucose葡萄糖） || 文化联想：米饭、面条、馒头是中国饮食里最熟悉的碳水化合物来源，最适合联想到 carbohydrate，可以说 **dietary carbohydrate — “Rice, noodles, and steamed buns are major sources of dietary carbohydrate in many Chinese meals.”**

quiz.question: aerate ____
quiz.explanation: 使充气，使土壤充气。Gardeners use special tools to aerate soil and improve drainage. 园丁使用特殊工具使土壤充气并改善排水。 | aer->空气（希腊aer），aerate->使充满空气（cf. air空气，aerial空中，aero航空，anaerobic无氧，atmosphere大气层） || 文化联想：春耕翻土能让板结的土壤更疏松透气，最适合帮助记忆 aerate，可以说 **aerate the soil — “Turning and loosening the earth before planting helps aerate the soil so roots receive more oxygen.”**

quiz.question: deliberate ______
quiz.explanation: 深思熟虑的，深思熟虑的选择。Moving abroad was a deliberate choice after months of planning. 移居国外是经过数月规划后深思熟虑的选择。 | de->彻底，liber->称量/权衡（拉丁librare），deliberate->彻底权衡=深思熟虑的（cf. deliberation审议，libra天秤座，equilibrium平衡） || 文化联想：中文“三思而后行”最适合帮助记忆 deliberate，可以说 **a deliberate choice — “A decision made only after ‘thinking three times before acting’ is a deliberate choice rather than an impulse.”**

quiz.question: lacerate ____
quiz.explanation: 撕裂，撕裂皮肤。Sharp thorns can lacerate skin if not handled carefully. 如果不小心处理，尖锐的刺会撕裂皮肤。 | lacer->撕裂（拉丁lacerare），lacerate->撕裂（cf. laceration撕裂伤，tear撕裂，rend撕裂，lacerating撕裂性的） || 文化联想：山路荆棘划破皮肤的场景最适合联想到 lacerate，可以说 **lacerate the skin — “Sharp thorns on a mountain path can lacerate the skin if a hiker pushes through them carelessly.”**

quiz.question: ulcerate ______
quiz.explanation: 溃烂，使组织溃烂。Prolonged pressure can ulcerate tissue and cause bedsores. 长时间的压力会使组织溃烂并导致褥疮。 | ulc->溃疡（拉丁ulcus），ulcerate->形成溃疡=溃烂（cf. ulcer溃疡，ulcerous溃疡的，erode腐蚀，suppurate化脓） || 文化联想：久卧不起的老人如果护理不足可能形成褥疮并使组织溃烂，最适合联想到 ulcerate，可以说 **ulcerate the tissue — “Prolonged pressure on the same area can ulcerate the tissue and produce a bedsore.”**

quiz.question: incarcerate _ _______
quiz.explanation: 监禁，监禁嫌疑人。The judge ordered authorities to incarcerate a suspect pending trial. 法官命令当局在审判前监禁嫌疑人。 | in->进入，carcer->监狱（拉丁），incarcerate->关进监狱=监禁（cf. carceral监狱的，jail监狱，prison监狱，incarceration监禁） || 文化联想：古代县衙把等待审讯的重罪嫌犯关进牢房，可以帮助记忆 incarcerate，可以说 **incarcerate a suspect — “A magistrate in a historical drama may order guards to incarcerate a suspect while the case is investigated.”**

quiz.question: eviscerate ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 削弱，严重削弱预算。Budget cuts threatened to eviscerate the budget for public education. 预算削减威胁要严重削弱公共教育的预算。 | e->向外，viscer->内脏（拉丁viscera），eviscerate->取出内脏=使空洞化/严重削弱（cf. visceral内脏的，gut肠，disembowel取出内脏） || 文化联想：中文“把预算砍到只剩空壳”最适合帮助记忆 eviscerate，可以说 **eviscerate a budget — “Cutting nearly every major program can eviscerate a public-service budget until little remains but its name.”**

quiz.question: preponderate ____
quiz.explanation: 占优势，占优势于。Practical concerns preponderate over aesthetic ones. 实际考虑占优势于美学考虑。 | pre->之前，ponder->称量（拉丁ponderare），preponderate->在称量中处于前方=占优势（cf. ponderous沉重，pound磅，compensate补偿） || 文化联想：盖房子时安全、防雨、抗震往往比装饰更重要，很适合联想到 preponderate，可以说 **practical concerns preponderate over aesthetics — “When building a family home, structural safety and weather protection may preponderate over purely decorative concerns.”**

quiz.question: _____ proliferate
quiz.explanation: 增殖，细胞增殖。Cancer occurs when abnormal cells proliferate uncontrollably. 当异常细胞不受控制地增殖时就会发生癌症。 | proli->后代（拉丁proles），ferate->产生，proliferate->大量产生后代=增殖（cf. proletariat无产阶级=只有后代，prolific多产） || 文化联想：现代生物课讲癌症时，异常细胞失控增殖最适合帮助记忆 proliferate，可以说 **cells proliferate — “Cancer develops when abnormal cells proliferate without the normal controls that limit growth.”**

quiz.question: exaggerate ______
quiz.explanation: 夸大，夸大声明。Advertisers often exaggerate claims about product effectiveness. 广告商经常夸大关于产品有效性的声明。 | ex->加强，agger->堆（拉丁agger->土堆），exaggerate->堆积过多=夸大（cf. aggrandize扩大，aggregate聚集，exaggeration夸张） || 文化联想：“王婆卖瓜，自卖自夸”最适合帮助记忆 exaggerate，可以说 **exaggerate a claim — “A seller who praises his own product like Wang Po selling melons may exaggerate a claim far beyond what the evidence supports.”**

quiz.question: agglomerate _________
quiz.explanation: 聚集，聚集颗粒。The process causes fine particles to agglomerate into larger clumps. 该过程使细小颗粒聚集成较大的团块。 | ag->朝向，glomer->球（拉丁glomus->线团），agglomerate->向球团聚集（cf. conglomerate企业集团，glomerulus肾小球，glomerate聚集） || 文化联想：雾霾或工业粉尘中的细小颗粒在潮湿空气中可能逐渐聚成较大颗粒，很适合联想到 agglomerate，可以说 **particles agglomerate — “Under humid conditions, fine airborne particles can agglomerate into larger clusters.”**

quiz.question: ________ conglomerate
quiz.explanation: 企业集团，商业企业集团。The multinational business conglomerate owns companies in diverse industries. 跨国商业企业集团拥有多个行业的公司。 | con->共同，glomer->球，conglomerate->球状聚集=企业集团（cf. agglomerate聚集，glomerate集结，amalgamate合并） || 文化联想：横跨地产、零售、金融等多个行业的大型企业集团最适合联想到 conglomerate，可以说 **a business conglomerate — “A large business conglomerate may own companies in property, retail, finance, and manufacturing at the same time.”**

quiz.question: enumerate _______
quiz.explanation: 列举，列举原因。The report proceeded to enumerate reasons for the project's failure. 报告继续列举项目失败的原因。 | e->向外，numer->数字（拉丁numerus），enumerate->数出来=列举（cf. number数字，numeral数字，innumerable无数，numerical数字的） || 文化联想：中文写作里“第一、第二、第三”逐条列出理由，就是 enumerate 的最直观画面，可以说 **enumerate the reasons — “A clear report may enumerate the reasons one by one instead of burying them in a long paragraph.”**

quiz.question: unregenerate ______
quiz.explanation: 不知悔改的，不知悔改的罪人。The preacher spoke of the unregenerate sinner who refused to repent. 传教士谈到了拒绝悔改的不知悔改的罪人。 | un->否定，re->再次，gen->产生（拉丁），regenerate->再生，unregenerate->无法再生=不知悔改的（cf. generate产生，degenerate堕落，regeneration再生） || 文化联想：中文“死不悔改”几乎就是 unregenerate 的最佳联想，可以说 **an unregenerate wrongdoer — “Someone who continues the same wrongdoing and refuses every chance to repent is an unregenerate wrongdoer.”**

quiz.question: venerate _________
quiz.explanation: 尊敬，尊敬祖先。Many cultures venerate ancestors through regular ceremonies and offerings. 许多文化通过定期仪式和供品来尊敬祖先。 | vener->崇拜（拉丁venerari），venerate->崇拜=尊敬（cf. Venus金星/维纳斯，venerable可尊敬的，venereal性病=维纳斯的诅咒） || 文化联想：清明祭祖、敬奉先人最适合帮助记忆 venerate，可以说 **venerate one’s ancestors — “During Qingming, many families visit ancestral graves to remember and venerate their ancestors.”**

quiz.question: incinerate _____
quiz.explanation: 焚化，焚化废物。The facility was built to incinerate waste and generate electricity. 该设施建成用于焚化废物并发电。 | in->使，ciner->灰烬（拉丁cinis），incinerate->使变成灰烬=焚化（cf. cinderella灰姑娘=灰烬中的姑娘，cinder煤渣，incinerator焚化炉） || 文化联想：现代垃圾焚烧发电厂把生活垃圾高温焚化并回收能量，最适合联想到 incinerate，可以说 **incinerate waste — “A waste-to-energy plant can incinerate municipal waste while using the heat to generate electricity.”**

quiz.question: exonerate _________
quiz.explanation: 免罪，为被告免罪。DNA evidence helped exonerate defendant wrongly convicted years ago. DNA证据帮助为多年前被错误定罪的被告免罪。 | ex->向外，oner->重担（拉丁onus），exonerate->卸下重担=免罪（cf. onus责任，onerous繁重，exoneration免责，exculpate开脱） || 文化联想：包公故事里查明真相、替无辜者平反最适合帮助记忆 exonerate，可以说 **exonerate the accused — “When new evidence proves that a wrongly blamed person is innocent, a just magistrate should exonerate the accused.”**

quiz.question: remunerate _______
quiz.explanation: 给报酬，给工人报酬。Companies must fairly remunerate workers for overtime hours. 公司必须为加班时间公平地给工人报酬。 | re->回，muner->礼物/服务（拉丁munus），remunerate->回赠礼物=给报酬（cf. munificent慷慨，munitions军火，immunity免疫=免除服务） || 文化联想：中文“多劳多得、按劳取酬”最适合帮助记忆 remunerate，可以说 **fairly remunerate workers — “The principle of paying people according to their work requires an employer to remunerate workers fairly for overtime and skilled labor.”**

quiz.question: cooperate _______
quiz.explanation: 合作，密切合作。The two departments need to cooperate closely on this project. 两个部门需要在这个项目上密切合作。 | co->共同，oper->工作（拉丁opus），cooperate->共同工作=合作（cf. operate操作，operation手术，opus作品，inoperable无法手术） || 文化联想：“众人拾柴火焰高”最适合帮助记忆 cooperate，可以说 **cooperate closely — “The saying ‘many hands make the fire burn higher’ shows how people can cooperate closely to accomplish more together.”**

quiz.question: recuperate ______
quiz.explanation: 恢复，恢复健康。After the surgery, she went to the countryside to recuperate health. 手术后她去乡下恢复健康。 | re->再次，cup->抓取（拉丁capere），recuperate->再次抓回=恢复（cf. recover恢复，capture抓住，recapture重新夺回，recuperation康复） || 文化联想：中文“回乡静养”最适合帮助记忆 recuperate，可以说 **recuperate one’s health — “After a serious illness, someone may return to a quiet hometown to recuperate and slowly regain strength.”**

quiz.question: vituperate ______
quiz.explanation: 痛骂，疯狂地痛骂。The angry customer began to vituperate wildly about poor service. 愤怒的顾客开始疯狂地痛骂服务差。 | vitu->责备（拉丁vituperare），vituperate->强烈斥责=痛骂（cf. vituperation痛骂，upbraid责备，berate训斥，castigate严厉批评） || 文化联想：中文“破口大骂”最适合帮助记忆 vituperate，可以说 **vituperate wildly — “An enraged customer who starts shouting insults at everyone may vituperate wildly instead of explaining the problem calmly.”**

quiz.question: commiserate ____
quiz.explanation: 同情，同情于。Friends gathered to commiserate with her after the loss. 朋友们聚在一起对她的损失表示同情。 | com->共同，miser->悲惨（拉丁miser），commiserate->共同悲惨=同情（cf. misery悲惨，miserable悲惨，miser吝啬鬼，commiseration同情） || 文化联想：白居易“同是天涯沦落人”最适合帮助记忆 commiserate，可以说 **commiserate with one another — “Two people who discover that they have suffered the same misfortune may commiserate with one another, like ‘fellow wanderers at the ends of the earth.’”**

quiz.question: inveterate _____
quiz.explanation: 根深蒂固的，根深蒂固的习惯。Smoking had become an inveterate habit that he found impossible to break. 吸烟已成为他无法打破的根深蒂固的习惯。 | in->使，veter->老（拉丁vetus），inveterate->由来已久根深蒂固的（cf. veteran老兵，veterinarian兽医，veteran老手，vex困扰） || 文化联想：中文“积习难改”最适合帮助记忆 inveterate，可以说 **an inveterate habit — “A behavior practiced for decades may become an inveterate habit that is extremely difficult to change.”**

quiz.question: iterate ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 重复，重复过程。The team needs to iterate the process until they achieve optimal results. 团队需要重复该过程直到获得最佳结果。 | iter->再次（拉丁iterum->再次），iterate->再次做=重复（cf. reiterate重申，iteration迭代，iterative迭代的，algorithm算法） || 文化联想：景德镇工匠反复试烧、调整釉料直到颜色稳定，最适合联想到 iterate，可以说 **iterate the process — “A ceramic workshop may iterate the process of mixing glaze, firing a test piece, and adjusting the formula until the color is right.”**

quiz.question: reiterate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 重申，重申观点。The professor paused to reiterate the point for emphasis. 教授停下来重申这一观点以示强调。 | re->再次，iter->再次，reiterate->一再重复=重申（cf. iterate重复，iteration迭代，iterative迭代，repeat重复） || 文化联想：中文“重要的事说三遍”最适合帮助记忆 reiterate，可以说 **reiterate the point — “A teacher who wants students to remember one key rule may reiterate the point several times.”**

quiz.question: literate _______
quiz.explanation: 有文化的，有文化的社会。A literate society enjoys greater economic and social mobility. 有文化的社会享有更大的经济和社会流动性。 | liter->字母（拉丁littera），literate->懂字母的=有文化的（cf. literature文学，literal字面的，illiterate文盲，alliterate押头韵） || 文化联想：现代义务教育普及后形成高识字率社会的场景很适合联想到 literate，可以说 **a literate society — “Universal schooling helps create a literate society in which most people can read everyday texts and public information.”**

quiz.question: preliterate _______
quiz.explanation: 文字出现前的，文字出现前的社会。Anthropologists study preliterate society through oral traditions. 人类学家通过口头传统研究文字出现前的社会。 | pre->之前，literate->有文字的，preliterate->文字出现之前的（cf. literate有文化，illiterate文盲，literature文学，letter字母） || 文化联想：甲骨文出现之前的新石器社会主要依靠口述、器物和符号传承信息，最适合联想到 preliterate，可以说 **a preliterate society — “A Neolithic community before the development of full writing can be described as a preliterate society whose history survives mainly through archaeology and oral tradition.”**

quiz.question: alliterate _____
quiz.explanation: 押头韵，押头韵的词。The poet carefully chose to alliterate words for rhythmic effect. 诗人精心选择押头韵的词以产生韵律效果。 | al->朝向，liter->字母，alliterate->在字母上对齐=押头韵（cf. alliteration头韵，letter字母，literal字面，literate有文化） || 文化联想：汉语传统音韵学里的“双声”与 alliteration 很接近，例如“玲珑”两个音节都以 l 开头，可以说 **alliterate two words — “In Chinese phonology, a 双声 pair such as ‘玲珑’ repeats the same initial sound and therefore resembles words that alliterate.”**

quiz.question: adulterate ____
quiz.explanation: 掺假，在葡萄酒中掺假。Unscrupulous merchants would adulterate wine with water to increase profits. 不道德的商人会在葡萄酒中掺水以增加利润。 | adulter->其他的（拉丁adulterare->使不纯），adulterate->加入其他物质=掺假（cf. adultery通奸=加入他者，adulterous不忠的） || 文化联想：中文“酒里掺水”就是 adulterate 最直观的画面，可以说 **adulterate wine — “A dishonest merchant who mixes water into wine to increase volume is trying to adulterate the wine.”**

quiz.question: integrate _______
quiz.explanation: 整合，整合系统。The IT department worked to integrate systems from different vendors. IT部门努力整合来自不同供应商的系统。 | integr->完整（拉丁integer），integrate->使完整=整合（cf. integer整数，integrity诚信=完整，integral积分，disintegrate瓦解） || 文化联想：中国企业数字化时常要把财务、库存和订单系统打通，最适合联想到 integrate，可以说 **integrate several systems — “A company may integrate its payment, inventory, and order systems so that information flows automatically between them.”**

quiz.question: disintegrate _______
quiz.explanation: 瓦解，迅速瓦解。Without proper leadership, the organization began to disintegrate rapidly. 没有适当的领导该组织开始迅速瓦解。 | dis->分开，integr->完整，disintegrate->使不完整=瓦解（cf. integrate整合，integrity诚信，integer整数，disintegration瓦解） || 文化联想：中文“树倒猢狲散”最适合帮助记忆 disintegrate，可以说 **an organization disintegrates — “When a group depends entirely on one leader, it may disintegrate rapidly once that leader falls—‘树倒猢狲散.’”**

quiz.question: emigrate __ ______
quiz.explanation: 移居国外，移居到加拿大。Many families chose to emigrate to Canada for better opportunities. 许多家庭选择移居到加拿大以获得更好的机会。 | e->向外，migr->移动（拉丁migrare），emigrate->向外移动=移居国外（cf. immigrate移入，migrate迁移，migrant移民，migration迁徙） || 文化联想：近代福建、广东很多人“下南洋”到东南亚谋生，是 emigrate 的经典中国历史场景，可以说 **emigrate overseas — “For generations, people from Fujian and Guangdong emigrated overseas to Southeast Asia in search of work and opportunity.”**

quiz.question: denigrate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 诋毁，诋毁同事。It is unprofessional to denigrate a colleague in front of clients. 在客户面前诋毁同事是不专业的。 | de->向下，nigr->黑（拉丁niger），denigrate->使变黑=诋毁（cf. negro（已废用），Nigeria尼日利亚，noir黑色，denigration诋毁） || 文化联想：中文“背后说人坏话、贬低同事”最适合帮助记忆 denigrate，可以说 **denigrate a colleague — “Trying to make oneself look better by denigrating a colleague is considered unprofessional and petty.”**

quiz.question: _________ ingrate
quiz.explanation: 忘恩负义的人，忘恩负义的人。After all their help, he turned out to be a thankless ingrate. 在他们提供了所有帮助之后，他竟然是个忘恩负义的人。 | in->否定，grat->感激（拉丁gratus），ingrate->不感激的人（cf. grateful感激，gratitude感激，ungrateful不感激，gratuitous无偿的） || 文化联想：东郭先生救了狼，狼反过来想吃掉他，正是“忘恩负义之徒”的经典形象，可以说 **a thankless ingrate — “The wolf in the story of Mr. Dongguo behaves like a thankless ingrate after receiving help and then turning on his benefactor.”**

quiz.question: irate ________
quiz.explanation: 愤怒的，愤怒的顾客。The manager had to deal with an irate customer demanding a refund. 经理不得不处理一位要求退款的愤怒顾客。 | ira->愤怒（拉丁），irate->充满愤怒的（cf. ire愤怒，irascible易怒的，ireful愤怒的，enrage激怒） || 文化联想：顾客因为退款问题拍桌子、怒气冲冲地找经理，最适合联想到 irate，可以说 **an irate customer — “A customer who pounds the counter and angrily demands an immediate refund is an irate customer.”**

quiz.question: elaborate ______
quiz.explanation: 精心制作的，精心制作的计划。The criminals devised an elaborate scheme to defraud investors. 罪犯设计了精心制作的计划来欺诈投资者。 | e->向外，labor->工作（拉丁laborare），elaborate->大量工作制作出=精心的（cf. labor工作，laborious费力，collaborate合作，laboratory实验室） || 文化联想：《三国演义》里的“连环计”层层相扣、设计复杂，很适合联想到 elaborate，可以说 **an elaborate scheme — “A stratagem made of several coordinated steps, like a ‘chain of schemes,’ can become an elaborate scheme.”**

quiz.question: corroborate _________
quiz.explanation: 证实，证实证词。Additional witnesses came forward to corroborate testimony given earlier. 更多证人站出来证实之前给出的证词。 | cor->加强，robor->力量（拉丁robur->橡木），corroborate->加强力量=证实（cf. robust强壮，corroboration证实，oak橡树，robustness坚固） || 文化联想：古代审案讲究口供、物证和其他证人彼此印证，最适合帮助记忆 corroborate，可以说 **corroborate testimony — “A second witness and a matching physical record can corroborate testimony given earlier and make the account more credible.”**
